name: io.github.physics-star-cat/databutler-uk-exam-dates
description: UK exam calendar facts verified against JCQ and the exam boards' own documents: GCSE and A-level results days, the summer 2027 exam timetable (JCQ window and the dates of GCSE Maths, English Language, Combined Science and A-level Maths papers at AQA, Pearson Edexcel, Cambridge OCR and WJEC/Eduqas), entry deadlines with each board's late-fee dates, Scotland's results day, and announced specification changes — each date with its source document, the quoted timetable row, verification date and the summer 2026 equivalent.
